# Claude models compared: cost vs quality at every effort level

> What each Claude model (Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku) costs at every effort level, and which gives the best quality for the price. Open data, CC BY 4.0.

Best value overall: Sonnet 5.5 at high effort, 3.0× cheaper than the price trend for its quality (expected score 66.5 % on the benchmark panel, cost 1.7× the cheapest couple). Best pick by task tier: grunt work → Sonnet 5.5 at low effort; everyday tasks → Sonnet 5.5 at medium effort; advanced reasoning → Opus 5.5 at high effort; cutting-edge thinking → Opus 5.5 at xHigh effort. Highest measured quality: Opus 5.5 at max effort (expected score 75.1 %, cost 17× the cheapest couple).

Costs are multiples of the cheapest couple's; quality is the expected score on the benchmark panel. Both are fused from measurements taken on the same task by a latent-quality model that estimates each benchmark's own scale (method: docs/METHODOLOGY.md in the source repository), from 242 sources · 723 benchmarks · 4490 measurements. Updated 2026-10-01. Figures are indicative, derived from public third-party measurements; not affiliated with Anthropic.

## Report

- [Claude models compared: cost vs quality at every effort level](https://claude-models.agensse.com/): quality vs cost per model and effort level, Pareto frontier, best pick per task tier, normalized cost matrix, method and sources.
- [Fable vs Opus vs Sonnet vs Haiku: Claude models head-to-head](https://claude-models.agensse.com/claude-models-head-to-head.html): every pair of Claude models compared effort by effort, and the cheapest effort of each that matches the other.

## Head-to-head

- Fable 5.1 vs Opus 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.1 costs 1.4× to 3.0× what Opus 5.5 costs and scores 1.1 to 5.1 points lower on the benchmark panel. To match Fable 5.1 at max (70.3 %, cost 24×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is medium (70.7 %, cost 3.3×): 7.3× cheaper per task. No Fable 5.1 setting reaches Opus 5.5 at max (75.1 %): Fable 5.1's best is max at 70.3 %.
- Fable 5.1 vs Sonnet 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.1 costs 1.9× to 6.7× what Sonnet 5.5 costs and scores between 3.0 points lower and 7.3 points higher on the benchmark panel. To match Fable 5.1 at max (70.3 %, cost 24×), the cheapest Sonnet 5.5 setting is xHigh (71.2 %, cost 3.6×): 6.7× cheaper per task. No Fable 5.1 setting reaches Sonnet 5.5 at max (73.3 %): Fable 5.1's best is max at 70.3 %.
- Fable 5.1 vs Haiku 4.5: Haiku 4.5 is measured at a single setting, with no effort levels, so the two are compared through their cheapest matches. No Haiku 4.5 setting reaches Fable 5.1 at max (70.3 %): Haiku 4.5's best is its only setting at 39.7 %. To match Haiku 4.5 (39.7 %, cost 1.0×), the cheapest Fable 5.1 setting is low (63.0 %, cost 6.3×): 6.3× dearer per task.
- Opus 5.5 vs Sonnet 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Opus 5.5 costs 1.4× to 2.9× what Sonnet 5.5 costs and scores 1.8 to 11.2 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Sonnet 5.5 setting reaches Opus 5.5 at max (75.1 %): Sonnet 5.5's best is max at 73.3 %. To match Sonnet 5.5 at max (73.3 %, cost 13×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is high (72.3 %, cost 4.0×): 3.2× cheaper per task.
- Opus 5.5 vs Haiku 4.5: Haiku 4.5 is measured at a single setting, with no effort levels, so the two are compared through their cheapest matches. No Haiku 4.5 setting reaches Opus 5.5 at max (75.1 %): Haiku 4.5's best is its only setting at 39.7 %. To match Haiku 4.5 (39.7 %, cost 1.0×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is low (64.1 %, cost 2.1×): 2.1× dearer per task.
- Sonnet 5.5 vs Haiku 4.5: Haiku 4.5 is measured at a single setting, with no effort levels, so the two are compared through their cheapest matches. No Haiku 4.5 setting reaches Sonnet 5.5 at max (73.3 %): Haiku 4.5's best is its only setting at 39.7 %. To match Haiku 4.5 (39.7 %, cost 1.0×), the cheapest Sonnet 5.5 setting is low (55.7 %, cost 1.0×): 1.0× dearer per task.
- Fable 5.1 vs Fable 5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.1 costs 0.8× to 1.1× what Fable 5 costs and scores 1.7 to 3.5 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Fable 5 setting reaches Fable 5.1 at max (70.3 %): Fable 5's best is max at 68.1 %. To match Fable 5 at max (68.1 %, cost 23×), the cheapest Fable 5.1 setting is high (67.2 %, cost 9.2×): 2.4× cheaper per task.
- Opus 5.5 vs Opus 5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Opus 5.5 costs 0.5× to 1.4× what Opus 5 costs and scores 2.9 to 6.1 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Opus 5 setting reaches Opus 5.5 at max (75.1 %): Opus 5's best is max at 68.9 %. To match Opus 5 at max (68.9 %, cost 12×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is medium (70.7 %, cost 3.3×): 3.7× cheaper per task.
- Sonnet 5.5 vs Sonnet 5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Sonnet 5.5 costs 0.5× to 1.5× what Sonnet 5 costs and scores 9.4 to 14.8 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Sonnet 5 setting reaches Sonnet 5.5 at max (73.3 %): Sonnet 5's best is max at 58.4 %. To match Sonnet 5 at max (58.4 %, cost 8.6×), the cheapest Sonnet 5.5 setting is medium (59.5 %, cost 1.1×): 7.7× cheaper per task. Sonnet 5's cost is size-sensitive: a verbose model, its cost swings widely between short and long agentic tasks, hence its wide interval.

- [raw-data.csv](https://claude-models.agensse.com/raw-data.csv): every measured row (source, model, effort, task, harness, cost, tokens, score, reference), CC BY 4.0.
